book_name: WFD 2025年8月9月预测练习句（拆分）  词组356句

words.tr: phrase. 志愿工作；义工职位
words.ex: He does volunteer jobs at the animal shelter.
words.ex_cn: 他在动物收容所做志愿者工作。
words.en: Volunteer jobs: Unpaid work undertaken by choice to benefit a cause or community.

words.tr: phrase. 与…有关
words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 社会的；社交的；
words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr: adj. 经济（上）的；
words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.tr: n. 背景；经历；
words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr: n. 教程；指南；“tutorial”的复数；
words.ex: He watches online tutorials to learn coding.
words.ex_cn: 他观看在线教程来学习编程。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching given by a tutor to an individual or a small group of students.

words.tr:
adj. 安排好时间的
v. 安排；“schedule”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The meeting is scheduled for 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议安排在下午三点。
words.en: If something is scheduled, it is planned to happen at a particular time.

words.tr: n. 议程；议事日程；
words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr: n. 物品；商品；项目；条款；“item”的复数；
words.ex: These items are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些物品在桌子上。
words.en: Objects or articles that are used for a particular purpose or are present in a situation.

words.tr: v. 顺从；顺从( submit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He submitted to the teacher's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他顺从了老师的规则。
words.en: If you submit to something, you unwillingly allow something to be done to you, or you do what someone wants, for example because you are not powerful enough to resist.

words.w: by the end of the day
words.tr: 短语. 到一天结束时；最迟在今天之内；最终
words.uk: baɪ ði end əv ðə deɪ
words.us: baɪ ði end əv ðə deɪ
words.ex: By the end of the day, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到一天结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Before the day is over; ultimately.

words.tr: 短语，表示“……的系统；……的体系”，用于描述某一类组织、方法或结构的整体安排
words.ex: He solved a system of two equations.
words.ex_cn: 他解了一个由两个方程组成的方程组。
words.en: A set of connected things or parts forming a complex whole.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.tr: n. 过程；进程；
words.ex: The processes of cooking and cleaning take time.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪和清洁的过程需要时间。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result. It can also refer to a natural series of changes or a method of doing or making something, especially one that is used in industry.

words.tr: n. 产量；输出；产物；
words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr: n. 反馈
words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: phrase. 院系办公室；教职员工办公室
words.ex: He went to the faculty office to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他去教工办公室寻求帮助。
words.en: The office where university teachers or academic staff work.

words.tr: phrase. 经济发展
words.ex: The country wants economic development to help its people.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望经济发展来帮助人民。
words.en: Economic development refers to the process by which the economic well-being and quality of life of a nation, region, or local community are improved according to targeted goals and objectives.

words.tr: n. 报告；展示；陈述；
words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 气候变化
words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.tr: 名词短语。教育程度；教育水平
words.ex: His educational level is high school.
words.ex_cn: 他的教育水平是高中。
words.en: The stage or standard of education that a person has achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 一次小组会议；团体聚会
words.ex: We had a group meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个小组会议。
words.en: A gathering of multiple individuals for discussion or collaboration.

words.tr: 短语：将于明天举行
words.ex: The meeting will be held tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: Scheduled to occur on the following day.

words.tr: phrase. 必须被提交的
words.ex_cn: 作业必须在周五前提交。
words.en: Required to be presented or handed in by a specified time.

words.tr: phrase. 需要被支持；需要得到支持；必须被支撑
words.ex: The child needs to be supported by his parents.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子需要父母的支持。
words.en: Requires evidence, justification, or backing to be considered valid or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 由政府
words.ex: The project was funded by the government.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目由政府资助。
words.en: by the national governing authority

words.tr: 所有学生
words.ex: All students must finish their homework.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都必须完成作业。
words.en: Every individual enrolled in an educational institution or course.

words.tr: v. 被期望参加；应该出席
words.ex: Students are expected to attend class every day.
words.ex_cn: 学生被要求每天上课。
words.en: Required or anticipated to be present at an event or activity.

words.tr: 名词短语，指十次实验室课程或实验课时段
words.ex: He attended ten lab sessions last semester.
words.ex_cn: 他上个学期参加了十次实验课。
words.en: Ten scheduled practical sessions in a laboratory setting.

words.tr: phrase. 每学期：表示某项费用或活动是按照每学期计算的。
words.ex: The course costs $500 per semester.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程每学期收费500美元。
words.en: For each semester; by the semester.

words.tr: phrase. 在数量上；从数量角度；以量化方式
words.ex: We measured the growth in quantitative terms.
words.ex_cn: 我们用数量术语来衡量增长。
words.en: Expressed or measured using numbers, statistics, or numerical data rather than qualitative descriptions.

words.tr: phrase. 这些任务；这些作业；这些分配的工作
words.ex: The assignments are due next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 这些作业下周一到期。
words.en: Tasks or projects assigned to be completed, often for assessment.

words.tr: phrase. 应该被提交给
words.ex: The report should be submitted to the teacher by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 报告应该在周五前提交给老师。
words.en: Required to be presented or delivered to a person or authority.

words.tr: phrase. 部门办公室
words.ex: I went to the department office to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 我去系办公室寻求帮助。
words.en: The administrative office of a specific department within an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 在截止日期之前
words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: Prior to the deadlines; in advance of the set time limits.

words.tr: phrase. 在他们的能力范围内；在他们的能力之内
words.ex: They can solve the problem in their ability.
words.ex_cn: 他们能在自己的能力范围内解决这个问题。
words.en: Regarding their capacity or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 批判性地思考；以批判性思维进行分析和评估
words.ex: He learns to think critically about problems.
words.ex_cn: 他学习如何对问题进行批判性思考。
words.en: To think critically means to analyze and evaluate an issue in order to form a judgment. It involves the objective analysis and evaluation of facts to form a judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 某些科学原理
words.ex: These certain scientific principles explain how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这些某些科学原理解释了植物是如何生长的。
words.en: Fundamental and established truths or rules in the field of science.

words.tr: phrase. 通过逻辑推理
words.ex: He found the answer by logical deduction.
words.ex_cn: 他通过逻辑推理找到了答案。
words.en: Using reasoning to reach a conclusion based on evidence and facts.

words.tr: phrase. 一种可以接受的现象
words.ex: It is an acceptable phenomenon when children sleep late on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在周末睡得很晚是一种可以接受的现象。
words.en: A situation or event that is considered normal or permissible within a given context.

words.tr: phrase. 在……群体中；在一群人之中
words.ex: He is the tallest among a group of boys.
words.ex_cn: 他在一群男孩中最高。
words.en: Within the membership or collective of a specific set of people.

words.tr: phrase. 声誉良好的科学家；有声望的科学家
words.ex: Reputable scientists published the results in a famous journal.
words.ex_cn: 著名的科学家将结果发表在一本知名期刊上。
words.en: Scientists with a good reputation for reliability and expertise.

words.tr: adv. 必须通过口头方式学习的
words.ex_cn: 这些规则必须通过口头学习。
words.en: Requires acquisition through spoken instruction or oral tradition rather than written text.

words.tr: phrase. 著名的；备受赞誉的理论
words.ex: Einstein is known for the celebrated theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 爱因斯坦因著名的相对论而闻名。
words.en: The well-known and respected theoretical framework.

words.tr: phrase. 重大的争议；激烈的争论
words.ex: There is great controversy about the new law.
words.ex_cn: 关于这项新法律，存在巨大争议。
words.en: A great controversy refers to a significant and often heated dispute or debate over a particular issue.

words.tr: n. 图书馆的会议室
words.ex: We met in the library conference room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在图书馆的会议室见面了。
words.en: A room in a library designated for meetings or conferences.

words.tr: 短语，许多学生；若干学生
words.ex: A number of students are waiting outside the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 一些学生正在教室外等候。
words.en: An unspecified quantity of learners.

words.tr: phrase. 最后的一周；最终的星期
words.ex: He works hard in the final week.
words.ex_cn: 他在最后一周努力工作。
words.en: The last week of a period, such as a semester or project.

words.tr: n. 术语；学期；期限
words.ex: In math, 'variable' is a common term.
words.ex_cn: 在数学中，'变量'是一个常见术语。
words.en: A specific period or word used in academic or technical contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 所有行业
words.ex: All industries need clean water.
words.ex_cn: 所有行业都需要干净的水。
words.en: All industries refers to every sector of economic activity, encompassing manufacturing, services, and other commercial enterprises.

words.tr: phrase. 所有的作业；全部的任务
words.ex: He finished all of the assignments before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了所有作业。
words.en: Every task or piece of work assigned to students.

words.tr: adv. 亲自；本人到场地
words.ex: I will talk to him in person to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 我会亲自和他谈谈来解决这个问题。
words.en: In a physical, face-to-face meeting rather than online or by phone.

words.tr: phrase. 你所有的作业或任务
words.ex: You must finish all of your assignments before Friday.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在周五之前完成所有的作业。
words.en: All of your assignments: Every piece of work or task given to you to complete.

words.tr: 短语. 应在明天之前完成或到期
words.ex: The homework are due by tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 作业必须在明天之前交。
words.en: Must be completed or submitted by the day after today.

words.tr: n. 花旗布
words.ex: The americans wear colorful flags on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 花旗布在独立日时被人们穿着。
words.en: Americans are people who are citizens of the United States of America, or who come from there.

words.tr: phrase. 通常定义；一般界定
words.ex: Scientists have typically defined success by measurable results.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们通常用可衡量的结果来定义成功。
words.en: Used to describe how something has been commonly characterized in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 植物生长的过程
words.ex: The process of plant growth takes many weeks.
words.ex_cn: 植物生长的过程需要很多周。
words.en: The series of changes that a plant undergoes from the beginning of its life until it reaches maturity, involving cell division, elongation, and differentiation.

words.tr: phrase. 介绍；引言；入门
words.ex: He gave an introduction to the new project.
words.ex_cn: 他对新项目做了一个介绍。
words.en: A preliminary section or part of a book, speech, or course that introduces the main subject.

words.tr: phrase. 必不可少的要素；基本成分
words.ex: Water is an essential element for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本要素。
words.en: A fundamental or necessary part of something.

words.tr: n. 学生；“student”的复数；
words.ex: The students are reading books in the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在图书馆里读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university, college, or school.

words.tr: v. 将会逐渐建立信心；增强自信
words.ex: He will develop confidence by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习来建立自信。
words.en: To gain or build self-assurance and belief in one's abilities.

words.tr: 短语. 仍然是……的来源
words.ex: The river is still the source of water for the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条河仍然是村庄水源的来源。
words.en: Continuing to be the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: phrase. 一种良好的建筑结构
words.ex: The old church is a good architectural structure.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧教堂是一个很好的建筑结构。
words.en: A good architectural structure: A well-designed and functional building or framework.

words.tr: phrase. 应该是有用的
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对初学者应该很有用。
words.en: Likely to be of help or benefit.

words.tr: phrase. 耐用且美观的
words.ex: This wooden table is durable and beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这张木桌坚固又美观。
words.en: Long-lasting and aesthetically pleasing.

words.tr: prep. 为学生做好准备；使学生适应（某事，如考试、工作等）
words.ex: The teacher prepares students for the math test.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生准备数学考试。
words.en: To equip or train students with the skills and knowledge needed for future challenges or careers.

words.tr: phrase. 专业实践；职业实务；行业惯例
words.ex: Engaging in professional practice requires continuous learning and adaptation.
words.ex_cn: 从事专业实践需要持续学习和适应。
words.en: Professional practice refers to the application of professional knowledge and skills in a real-world setting, often within a specific profession or field.

words.tr: n. 大型会议；“conference”的复数；
words.ex: Many scientists attend conferences to share their research.
words.ex_cn: 许多科学家参加大型会议来分享他们的研究。
words.en: A conference is a formal meeting where people gather to discuss matters of common interest, often over several days.

words.tr: modal v. 应该；理应；应当存在
words.ex: This solution ought to be considered carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这个解决方案应该被仔细考虑。
words.en: Used to express moral obligation, necessity, or strong recommendation; equivalent to 'should' or 'must'.

words.tr: adv. + adj. 总是被安排好的；一直有固定日程的
words.ex: The meeting is always scheduled for 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议总是安排在下午三点。
words.en: Occurring or arranged at a fixed or regular time.

words.tr: 短语. 提前两周
words.ex: You need to book the tickets two weeks in advance to get the early bird discount.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 你需要提前两周订票才能享受早鸟折扣。
words.en: phrase. Doing something two weeks before it is due or needed.

words.tr: phrase. 消费者信心；指消费者对经济形势、就业和收入前景的乐观或悲观程度
words.ex: Consumer confidence is high after the economy improved.
words.ex_cn: 经济改善后，消费者信心很高。
words.en: Consumer confidence refers to the degree of optimism that consumers feel about the overall state of the economy and their personal financial situation. How confident people feel about stability of their incomes determines their spending activity and therefore serves as one of the key indicators for the overall shape of the economy.

words.tr: phrase. 直接的影响；对某人或某事产生立即作用的力量或作用方式
words.ex: His words had a direct influence on her decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的决定产生了直接影响。
words.en: An immediate and unmediated effect on something.

words.tr: phrase. 正在打折的；特价的
words.ex: The clothes on sales are very cheap.
words.ex_cn: 正在打折的衣服非常便宜。
words.en: Available for purchase, typically at a reduced price.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 令人信服的证据；能够使人相信某事真实性的证据
words.ex: The lawyer presented convincing evidence that the defendant was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 律师提出了令人信服的证据，证明被告是无辜的。
words.en: Evidence that is so strong and clear that it makes you believe that something is true or exists.

words.tr: phrase. 支持这一理论
words.ex: The data supports this theory.
words.ex_cn: 这些数据支持这一理论。
words.en: To provide evidence or reasoning that backs up a particular idea or hypothesis.

words.tr: phrase. 难以获得；很难得到
words.ex: Fresh water is hard to obtain in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 在沙漠中，淡水很难获得。
words.en: is difficult to acquire or secure

words.tr: phrase. 尽管，不管
words.ex: They are friends, despite their differences.
words.ex_cn: 尽管他们有不同之处，他们还是朋友。
words.en: In spite of the fact that they are different.

words.tr: phrase. 所有生命形式；包括地球上存在的各种生物，如动物、植物、微生物等
words.ex: The conservation efforts aim to protect all forms of life in the rainforest.
words.ex_cn: 保护努力旨在保护雨林中的所有生命形式。
words.en: All forms of life refers to every living organism existing on Earth, encompassing the vast diversity of species in various ecosystems.

words.tr: phrase. 共享某些特征；具有某些共同特性
words.ex: The two species share certain characteristics that make them difficult to distinguish.
words.ex_cn: 这两个物种共享某些特征，使得它们难以区分。
words.en: To have some features or qualities in common with something or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 经济问题；经济困难；与资源分配、生产、消费等相关的社会经济难题
words.ex: The country faces serious economic problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家面临着严重的经济问题。
words.en: Economic problems refer to issues and challenges that affect the economy of a country or region, such as inflation, unemployment, and poverty.

words.tr: phrase. 导致大幅上升；引起显著增长
words.ex: The new policy caused a big rise in unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 新政策导致失业率大幅上升。
words.en: To lead to a significant increase in something.

words.tr: phrase. 处于失业状态；在失业中
words.ex: He is in unemployment after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后处于失业状态。
words.en: Referring to the rate of people without jobs who are actively seeking work.

words.tr: phrase. ……的学术实力；指某机构或个人在学术研究、教学水平等方面的优势或强项
words.ex: The academic strength of this school is its science program.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的学术优势是它的科学课程。
words.en: The level of academic achievement or capability of a person or institution.

words.tr: phrase. 早期罗马共和国（指公元前509年至公元前27年之间的罗马政体）
words.ex: The early Roman Republic had no kings.
words.ex_cn: 早期的罗马共和国没有国王。
words.en: The period of ancient Roman history from 509 BCE to 27 BCE, characterized by a republican government.

words.tr: phrase. 将被检查；将被审查；将被考试（被动语态结构）
words.ex: The results will be examined by the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会检查这些结果。
words.en: Will be examined means that something is scheduled or expected to be looked at or inspected in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 明天的讲座
words.ex: I will attend tomorrow's lecture on biology.
words.ex_cn: 我将参加明天的生物讲座。
words.en: The lecture scheduled for the following day.

words.tr: phrase. 被取消的
words.ex: The meeting has been canceled.
words.ex_cn: 会议已经被取消了。
words.en: Has been officially called off or stopped from happening.

words.tr: n. 学生；“student”的复数；
words.ex: The students are reading books in the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在图书馆里读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university, college, or school.

words.tr: verb. 被允许停车
words.ex: Visitors are permitted to park here after 6 PM.
words.ex_cn: 游客晚上6点后被允许在这里停车。
words.en: Allowed to leave a vehicle in a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 重要细节；关键信息
words.ex: He wrote down the important details in his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把重要的细节写在了笔记本上。
words.en: Crucial or essential pieces of information.

words.tr: phrase. 从论证中；根据论点
words.ex: He stepped back from the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他从争论中退了出来。
words.en: Derived from a set of reasons or a debate.

words.tr: v. 正在失踪的；不见了的
words.ex: They are missing their bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们错过了他们的公交车。
words.en: Not present or cannot be found.

words.tr: 短语. 总的来说；概括地说
words.ex: In the summary, he said the story was about friendship.
words.ex_cn: 在总结中，他说这个故事是关于友谊的。
words.en: In the brief statement of main points.

words.tr: phrase. 这真的很…；它的确非常…
words.ex: It is really hard to understand algebra without practice.
words.ex_cn: 如果没有练习，理解代数真的很难。
words.en: In reality; used for emphasis.

words.tr: phrase. 一个全面的计划或项目；涵盖广泛内容的系统性方案
words.ex: The school offers a comprehensive program for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供一个全面的项目。
words.en: A comprehensive program refers to a detailed and thorough plan or system that covers all aspects of a particular subject or activity.

words.tr: v. 覆盖；“cover”的现在分词； n. 遮盖物；
words.ex: The snow is covering the ground.
words.ex_cn: 雪覆盖着地面。
words.en: A covering is a layer of something that spreads over or encloses something else, often to protect it or hide it.

words.tr: 我们正在研究（进行调查或学术探索）
words.ex: We are researching how plants grow in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在研究植物在黑暗中如何生长。
words.en: We are investigating or studying a subject systematically.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的挑战；最具意义的难题
words.ex: The most significance challenges are hard to solve.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的挑战很难解决。
words.en: The greatest or most important difficulties.

words.tr: 短语. 我们社会中所面临的问题或挑战
words.ex: Many people are faced with poverty in our society.
words.ex_cn: 在我们的社会中，许多人面临贫困。
words.en: Experienced or encountered in our community or culture.

words.tr:
adv. 在今天；当今；
n. 今天；当今；
words.ex: I will finish my homework today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.tr: n. 倾听；收听； v. 听；“listen”的现在分词；
words.ex: Good listening helps you understand others.
words.ex_cn: 良好的倾听能帮助你理解他人。
words.en: The act of paying attention to and trying to hear something.

words.tr: phrase. 是关键技能
words.ex: Reading is the key skill for learning.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学习的关键技能。
words.en: The most essential ability or talent.

words.tr: phrase. 成功所必需的；为取得成功所需要的
words.ex: He needed to succeed to help his family.
words.ex_cn: 他需要成功来帮助他的家人。
words.en: Required for achieving a desired outcome or success.

words.tr: phrase. 在这门课程中；在本课程期间
words.ex: In this course, we learn basic math.
words.ex_cn: 在这门课上，我们学习基础数学。
words.en: Within the context of this specific academic module or class.

words.tr: phrase. 医学研究人员
words.ex: Medical researchers are working tirelessly to find a cure for cancer.
words.ex_cn: 医学研究人员正在不懈努力寻找治疗癌症的方法。
words.en: Medical researchers are professionals who conduct studies and experiments to advance medical knowledge and develop new treatments.

words.tr: phrase. 一直专注于；集中于
words.ex: He has focused on math problems all day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都专注于数学题。
words.en: To concentrate attention or effort on something specific.

words.tr: phrase. 疾病的原因和治疗方法
words.ex: Doctors study causes of diseases and treatments to help patients.
words.ex_cn: 医生研究疾病的病因和治疗方法来帮助病人。
words.en: Factors leading to illnesses and the methods used to cure or manage them.

words.tr: phrase. 大多数理论；大部分学说
words.ex: Most theories say that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 大多数理论认为水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: most theories: the majority of academic models or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 非常相似的；颇为相像的
words.ex: Their opinions are quite similar on this matter.
words.ex_cn: 在这个问题上，他们的观点非常相似。
words.en: Very similar; almost the same.

words.tr: phrase. 母语使用者；以该语言为母语的人
words.ex: Native speakers speak English fluently.
words.ex_cn: 母语者说英语很流利。
words.en: Native speakers are people who have spoken a particular language since they were very young, and for whom it is their first language.

words.tr: phrase. 免除，豁免于（某义务、责任或规定）
words.ex: Small businesses are exempt from certain taxes.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 小型企业被免除某些税款。
words.en: To be exempt from something means to be free from an obligation, duty, or payment that others are required to make or do.

words.tr: 名词短语，语言测试；语言考试
words.ex: He passed the language tests last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周通过了语言考试。
words.en: Examinations designed to assess proficiency in a particular language.

words.tr: phrase. 用他们自己的语言；以他们本族语
words.ex: They speak in their own language at home.
words.ex_cn: 他们在家里用他们的母语交谈。
words.en: Using the language that is native or most familiar to a particular person or group.

words.tr: phrase. 同伴群体压力；来自同龄人群体的影响或压力
words.ex: Teenagers often face peer group pressure to conform to certain behaviors.
words.ex_cn: 青少年常常面临同龄人群体压力，要求他们遵循某些行为。
words.en: The influence exerted by a peer group, encouraging individuals to change their attitudes, values, or behaviors in order to conform to group norms.

words.tr: phrase. 显著的影响；重大的效果
words.ex: The new policy had a significant effect on the economy.
words.ex_cn: 新政策对经济产生了显著影响。
words.en: A noticeable or important effect or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 对年轻人而言；关于年轻人的
words.ex: Social media affects on young people.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体影响年轻人。
words.en: Relating to or affecting people in their late childhood or teenage years.

words.tr: phrase. 请核实信息；请检查资料
words.ex: Please check the information.
words.ex_cn: 请检查一下信息。
words.en: A polite request to verify or confirm the accuracy of given details, data, or facts.

words.tr: phrase. 在网站上；在该网站
words.ex: The information is on the website.
words.ex_cn: 信息在网站上。
words.en: Available or published on the internet.

words.tr: 用于表示查询或说明开放时间的短语，如营业时间、入场时间等
words.ex: The shop is open for the opening times.
words.ex_cn: 商店在营业时间内开放。
words.en: During the hours when a place is open to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 请确保；请务必确认
words.ex: Please make sure you bring your homework.
words.ex_cn: 请确保你带了作业。
words.en: An instruction to ensure that something is done or happens.

words.tr: v. 正确地引用了；准确地引证了
words.ex: He have correctly cited the book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在他的论文中正确引用了这本书。
words.en: Provided references or sources in a proper and accurate manner.

words.tr: adj. 所有必要的材料
words.ex: He brought all the necessary materials to class.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有必要的材料带到了课堂。
words.en: All the essential resources or items required for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 你所有的作业或任务
words.ex: You must finish all of your assignments before Friday.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在周五之前完成所有的作业。
words.en: All of your assignments: Every piece of work or task given to you to complete.

words.tr: 短语. 应在周三到期；应于周三支付或提交
words.ex: The homework are due on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 作业定于星期三交。
words.en: The deadline for submission is Wednesday.

words.tr: n. 护理临床实习；护理专业学生在医疗机构中进行的实践培训，以获得实际护理经验
words.ex: She did her clinical placement in nursing at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她在当地医院完成了护理的临床实习。
words.en: A period of practical training for nursing students in a healthcare setting.

words.tr: 由于停电
words.ex: The lights went out due to the power cut.
words.ex_cn: 由于停电，灯灭了。
words.en: Because of the power outage.

words.tr: phrase. 校园停车场的停车位
words.ex: Students park their cars at campus parking spaces.
words.ex_cn: 学生把车停在校园停车位。
words.en: Spaces for vehicles located at a university or college area.

words.tr: 名词短语，理论与实践两者
words.ex: To succeed in this field, you need to master both theory and practice.
words.ex_cn: 要在这个领域取得成功，你需要掌握理论与实践。
words.en: The combination of theoretical knowledge and practical application.

words.tr: 短语. 一些评论家持不同意见
words.ex: A few critics disagreed with the movie's ending.
words.ex_cn: 一些评论家不同意这部电影的结局。
words.en: Some reviewers or commentators held opposing views.

words.tr: 短语，政治通常不是
words.ex: Politics is not usually taught in primary school.
words.ex_cn: 政治通常不在小学教授。
words.en: Political matters are typically not considered.

words.tr: phrase. 一个安全的谈话话题，指不容易引起争议或冒犯的交流主题
words.ex: Weather is a safe topic of conversation.
words.ex_cn: 天气是一个安全的谈话话题。
words.en: A subject that is unlikely to cause disagreement or offence.

words.tr: phrase. 临床实习；临床轮转（指医学生或护理学生在医疗机构中进行的实践培训）
words.ex: Students go to hospitals for clinical placements.
words.ex_cn: 学生去医院进行临床实习。
words.en: Periods of supervised practical work in a medical or healthcare setting for students.

words.tr: phrase. 在护理领域；在护理工作中；在护理专业中
words.ex: He is working in nursing after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后从事护理工作。
words.en: In the field or profession of nursing.

words.tr: phrase. 由于；应归于
words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.tr: n. 停电；电源中断
words.ex: The power cut happened last night.
words.ex_cn: 停电发生在昨晚。
words.en: An interruption in the supply of electricity.

words.tr: phrase. 校园停车空间；校园内的停车位
words.ex: There is no campus parking space left for students.
words.ex_cn: 校园里没有留给学生的停车位了。
words.en: A designated spot within a larger parking area for a single vehicle on a university campus.

words.tr: phrase. 公众认知；公众看法；社会舆论
words.ex: The public perception of the company has improved significantly since the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 自从丑闻以来，公众对公司的看法有了显著改善。
words.en: The way in which the general public views or understands something, especially something related to a person, organization, or issue.

words.tr: phrase. 关于生物技术的
words.ex: He is learning about biotechnology in school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习生物技术。
words.en: Relating to the use of living organisms or their products for practical purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 对……至关重要；对……极为关键
words.ex: Water is crucial for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: Is crucial for: Is extremely important or essential for a particular purpose or outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 正在形成的科学共识；指科学界对某一问题逐渐达成的共同看法或一致意见
words.ex: The conference focused on developing scientific consensus on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 会议的重点是就气候变化发展科学共识。
words.en: The process of reaching a general agreement among scientists on a particular issue or topic.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.tr: phrase. 一种流行的娱乐形式
words.ex: Movies are a popular form of entertainment for many people.
words.ex_cn: 电影是许多人的一种流行娱乐形式。
words.en: A widely enjoyed activity or performance that provides amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr: phrase. 遍及全世界；在世界各地
words.ex: The news spread quickly throughout the world.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息迅速传遍了全世界。
words.en: In or to every part of the world.

words.tr: phrase. 所谓的好处；被假设存在的益处
words.ex: He believes in the supposed benefits of daily exercise.
words.ex_cn: 他相信每日锻炼的所谓好处。
words.en: The alleged or claimed advantages.

words.tr: phrase. 太空探索；对宇宙空间的科学探测与研究
words.ex: NASA is doing space exploration to learn about other planets.
words.ex_cn: 美国宇航局正在进行太空探索，以了解其他行星。
words.en: The investigation of physical conditions in space and on stars, planets, and other celestial bodies through the use of satellites, space probes, or spacecraft with human crews.

words.tr: phrase. 经常被质疑；频繁地受到询问
words.ex: The witnesses are frequently questioned by the police.
words.ex_cn: 证人们经常被警察询问。
words.en: Are often doubted or challenged.

words.tr: 短语，表示“说话者开始”或“演讲者开始了”
words.ex: The speaker began to talk about math.
words.ex_cn: 演讲者开始谈论数学。
words.en: The speaker started speaking.

words.tr: phrase. 通过给出一个概要或提纲
words.ex: He wrote the essay by giving an outline first.
words.ex_cn: 他先列了一个提纲，然后写了作文。
words.en: By providing a brief summary or general description of a topic.

words.tr: phrase. 属于她的演讲；在她的陈述中
words.ex: She practiced the of her presentation every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天练习她的演示文稿的内容。
words.en: Relating to the presentation she is giving or has given.

words.tr: 她已经制造了；她已经取得（成就）；她已经做出（决定等）
words.ex: She has made a cake for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她弟弟做了一个蛋糕。
words.en: She has created or produced.

words.tr: phrase. 重要的贡献；重大的捐献
words.ex: Her research was a significant contribution to the field of science.
words.ex_cn: 她的研究是对科学领域的重大贡献。
words.en: A significant contribution is an important addition or donation that has a major impact or effect in a particular area or field.

words.tr: phrase. 化学领域；化学学科范围
words.ex: He works in the field of chemistry.
words.ex_cn: 他在化学领域工作。
words.en: The scientific discipline that deals with the composition, structure, properties, and changes of matter.

words.tr: phrase. 一些经济学家
words.ex: Some economists say prices will rise.
words.ex_cn: 一些经济学家说价格会上涨。
words.en: Certain economists argue that.

words.tr: phrase. 主张；认为（后接从句，表示提出理由支持某一观点）
words.ex: He argues that homework is useless.
words.ex_cn: 他认为作业没有用。
words.en: Present a case or reason in support of a particular viewpoint.

words.tr: phrase. 整个金融体系
words.ex: The entire financial system was affected by the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 整个金融体系都受到了经济危机的影响。
words.en: The complete network of institutions, markets, and regulations that facilitate the flow of money and credit in an economy.

words.tr: phrase. 有致命缺陷的；存在严重到导致失败或毁灭性后果的缺陷
words.ex: The design was fatally flawed and led to the bridge's collapse.
words.ex_cn: 这个设计有致命缺陷，导致了桥梁的倒塌。
words.en: Having a defect or weakness that leads to failure or destruction.

words.tr: 短语。一些人认为；有些人主张（用于引出观点或争议性论点）
words.ex: Some people argue that homework helps students learn.
words.ex_cn: 有些人认为作业有助于学生学习。
words.en: A phrase used to introduce a contrasting opinion or viewpoint.

words.tr: phrase. 教育并非那么重要的
words.ex: He thinks education is not that important.
words.ex_cn: 他认为教育没那么重要。
words.en: Formal instruction is not of great significance.

words.tr: some students: 一些学生
words.ex: Some students are learning algebra this year.
words.ex_cn: 一些学生今年正在学习代数。
words.en: A number of students.

words.tr: phrase. 发现；查明；认为
words.ex: I find that math is easy.
words.ex_cn: 我发现数学很简单。
words.en: To discover or determine through experience or study.

words.tr: phrase. 判断题（要求判断陈述为真或假的问题）
words.ex: The exam consisted of 20 true or false questions.
words.ex_cn: 考试包括20道判断题。
words.en: A type of question that requires the respondent to determine whether a statement is true or false.

words.tr: adj. 比简答题更难的
words.ex: This math problem is harder than short answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题比简答题更难。
words.en: More difficult than brief responses.

words.tr: phrase. 统计结果
words.ex: The statistical results show a clear trend.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计结果显示出一个明显的趋势。
words.en: The outcomes or findings obtained from the analysis of data using statistical methods.

words.tr: v. 应该被表达
words.ex: The answer should be expressed as a fraction.
words.ex_cn: 答案应该用分数表示。
words.en: must be communicated or conveyed

words.tr: phrase. 以不同的方式；用不同的方法；通过不同的途径
words.ex: We solved the problem in different ways.
words.ex_cn: 我们用不同的方法解决了这个问题。
words.en: In various manners or methods.

words.tr: phrase. 视……而定；取决于
words.ex: It depends on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这取决于天气。
words.en: used to say that something is decided by or changes according to another thing

words.tr: phrase. 环境；情况；境况（特指某事件或行为发生的背景或条件）
words.ex: He changed his mind because of the circumstances.
words.ex_cn: 他因为情况变化而改变了主意。
words.en: The conditions or facts that affect a situation or event.

words.tr: 短语：建议你使用
words.ex: You are advised to use a calculator for this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 建议你用计算器来解这道数学题。
words.en: It is recommended that you use something.

words.tr: phrase. 多元研究方法；多种研究手段
words.ex: The study employed multiple research methods to ensure comprehensive data collection.
words.ex_cn: 该研究采用了多种研究方法，以确保数据的全面收集。
words.en: The use of various techniques and approaches in conducting research to gather and analyze data.

words.tr: phrase. 为了这个项目
words.ex: We need to finish this project by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要在周五前完成这个项目。
words.en: In connection with or intended for this specific task or undertaking.

words.tr: phrase. 科技领域的新发展；技术的新进展
words.ex: There is a new development in technology that helps people talk faster.
words.ex_cn: 科技出现了一项新进展，帮助人们更快地交流。
words.en: Recent advancements or innovations in technology.

words.tr: phrase. 影响当前研究；对现有研究产生作用
words.ex: The new theory is influencing current research in physics.
words.ex_cn: 这个新理论正在影响当前的物理研究。
words.en: Shaping or affecting ongoing scientific or academic studies.

words.tr: 名词短语：本课程的评估
words.ex: The assessments of this course are easy.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的评估很简单。
words.en: The evaluations for this course.

words.tr: 短语. 下周将开始
words.ex: The class will begin next week.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在下周开始。
words.en: Will commence next week.

words.tr: phrase. 数字革命；指信息技术迅猛发展带来的社会、经济和文化变革
words.ex: The digital revolution has transformed the way we communicate and access information.
words.ex_cn: 数字革命改变了我们交流和获取信息的方式。
words.en: The digital revolution refers to the shift from mechanical and analogue electronic technology to digital electronics which began anywhere from the late 1950s to the late 1970s with the adoption and proliferation of digital computers and digital record keeping that continues to the present day.

words.tr: verb phrase. 已经改变了……的方式
words.ex: The internet has changed the way we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 互联网改变了我们的交流方式。
words.en: Altered the manner or method in which something is done.

words.tr: we read 是一个短语，表示“我们读”，其中 'we' 是主格代词，意为“我们”；'read' 是动词原形，意为“读”，发音为 /riːd/，用于一般现在时，如：We read books every day. 我们每天读书。
words.ex: We read a book about algebra last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚读了一本关于代数的书。
words.en: We read a text.

words.tr: phrase. 地球的大气层；包围地球的气体层
words.ex: The earth's atmosphere keeps us warm.
words.ex_cn: 地球的大气层让我们保持温暖。
words.en: The layer of gases surrounding the Earth.

words.tr: phrase. 主要由……组成；首要地由……构成
words.ex: The salad is primarily composed of lettuce and tomatoes.
words.ex_cn: 这道沙拉主要由生菜和番茄组成。
words.en: Made up mainly of; consisting chiefly of.

words.tr: phrase. 氧气和氮气（气体）
words.ex: Air contains oxygen and nitrogen gases.
words.ex_cn: 空气中含有氧气和氮气。
words.en: Gaseous elements that make up most of the Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 大学的历史
words.ex: The history of the university dates back to the 19th century.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学的历史可以追溯到19世纪。
words.en: The chronological account of the origin and development of a university.

words.tr: 短语，指一个漫长而有趣的（事物），常用于描述故事、经历等
words.ex: He read a long and interesting one about ancient Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古埃及的又长又有趣的一本书。
words.en: A lengthy and engaging field of study.

words.tr: phrase. 这个岛屿（特指某个已知或上下文明确的岛）
words.ex: The island is small and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛很小且安静。
words.en: The landmass surrounded by water.

words.tr: phrase. 位于；坐落在
words.ex: The school is located at 123 Main Street.
words.ex_cn: 学校位于主街123号。
words.en: Is situated at a particular place or point.

words.w: the south end of the bay
words.tr: phrase. 海湾的南端
words.uk: ðə saʊθ end ɒv ðə beɪ
words.us: ðə saʊθ end ʌv ðə beɪ
words.ex: We anchored our boat at the south end of the bay.
words.ex_cn: n. 我们把船停泊在海湾的南端。
words.en: The southernmost part of a bay, often characterized by specific geographical or environmental features.

words.tr: phrase. 最重要的细节
words.ex: He wrote down the most important details.
words.ex_cn: 他记下了最重要的细节。
words.en: The most significant points or facts.

words.tr: prep. 在这个争论中；在此论点中
words.ex: In this argument, he says the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 在这个论点中，他说天空是蓝色的。
words.en: In this line of reasoning.

words.tr: v. 正在失踪的；不见了的
words.ex: They are missing their bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们错过了他们的公交车。
words.en: Not present or cannot be found.

words.tr: phrase. 铁路
words.ex: The railway runs through the village.
words.ex_cn: 铁路穿过这个村庄。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel tracks.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使长途旅行成为可能或更容易
words.ex: Planes makes long-distance travel easy.
words.ex_cn: 飞机让长途旅行变得容易。
words.en: Facilitates or enables travel over great distances.

words.tr: adj. 对每个人来说都是可能的
words.ex: It is possible for everyone to learn math.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有可能学会数学。
words.en: Achievable or attainable by all people.

words.tr: phrase. 沿海社区；沿海地区居民群体
words.ex: Coastal communities rely on fishing for their income.
words.ex_cn: 沿海社区依靠捕鱼为生。
words.en: Groups of people living in areas near the sea or ocean.

words.tr: phrase. 特别地；尤其 | adj. 易受伤害的；脆弱的
words.ex: Children are particularly vulnerable to cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 儿童特别容易受寒冷天气的影响。
words.en: Especially susceptible to physical or emotional harm or attack.

words.tr: 介词短语，表示‘由于海平面上升’或‘面对海平面上升’，常用于描述气候变化带来的影响
words.ex: The city is building walls because of to rising sea levels.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在修建围墙，因为海平面在上升。
words.en: As a result of increasing ocean levels.

words.tr: n.作业
words.ex: He finishes his assignments every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上完成作业。
words.en: Tasks or pieces of work that are assigned to someone, especially as part of their studies or job.

words.tr: phrase. 必须被提交的
words.ex_cn: 作业必须在周五前提交。
words.en: Required to be presented or handed in by a specified time.

words.w: at the end of the term
words.tr: 短语. 在学期结束时
words.ex: We will have a final exam at the end of the term.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在学期结束时进行期末考试。
words.en: At the end of the term refers to the conclusion of an academic period, typically a semester or school year.

words.w: the theme of the instrumental work
words.tr: phrase. 器乐作品的主题
words.uk: ðə θiːm əv ðə ɪnˈstrʊməntəl wɜːk
words.us: ðə θim əv ðə ɪnˈstrʌməntəl wɜrk
words.ex: The theme of the instrumental work is simple and calm.
words.ex_cn: 这首器乐作品的主题简单而平静。
words.en: The central idea or subject explored in a piece of instrumental music.

words.tr: v. 展示更多；陈列更多
words.ex: The dog exhibits more energy than the cat.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗比这只猫更有活力。
words.en: Shows a greater amount or degree of a particular quality or characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 一种端庄含蓄的创作风格
words.ex: She uses a demure compositional style in her paintings.
words.ex_cn: 她在绘画中使用了一种含蓄的构图风格。
words.en: A restrained, understated manner of creating artistic or written works, often characterized by subtlety and quiet elegance.

words.tr: phrase. 安全眼镜；护目镜
words.ex: Before starting the experiment, he put on his safety glasses.
words.ex_cn: 在开始实验之前，他戴上了他的安全眼镜。
words.en: Safety glasses are protective eyewear that usually enclose or protect the area surrounding the eye in order to prevent particulates, water or chemicals from striking the eyes.

words.tr: v. 应该被穿戴
words.ex: The helmet should be worn during bike rides.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时应该戴头盔。
words.en: Is intended to be put on the body as clothing or protection.

words.tr: phrase. 在做实验的时候；进行实验期间
words.ex: He forgot his notes while doing experiments.
words.ex_cn: 他在做实验时忘了笔记。
words.en: During the process of conducting scientific tests or investigations.

words.tr: phrase. 在实验室里
words.ex: He is working in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他正在实验室里工作。
words.en: Within a laboratory, a room or building equipped for scientific experiments.

words.tr: phrase. 来访的演讲者；客座讲者
words.ex: The visiting speaker will give a lecture on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 来访的演讲者将就气候变化发表演讲。
words.en: A visiting speaker is a person who comes to a place, such as a school or organization, to give a speech or lecture.

words.tr: 过去常常是一名讲师；曾经担任讲师职务
words.ex: He used to be a lecturer at a small university.
words.ex_cn: 他曾经是一所小大学的讲师。
words.en: Previously held the position of a university teacher.

words.tr: prep. 在这个部门
words.ex: He works in this department.
words.ex_cn: 他在这一个部门工作。
words.en: Within this specific academic or organizational division.

words.tr: 短语：显然存在一种需求；明确有必要
words.uk: ðeər ɪz ə klɪə n iːd
words.ex: There is a clear need for more clean water.
words.ex_cn: 很明显需要更多的干净水。
words.en: Something is definitely required.

words.tr: 用于进一步的研究
words.ex: The data collected will be used for further research.
words.ex_cn: 收集的数据将用于进一步研究。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is intended for additional study or investigation.

words.tr: phrase. 在该领域
words.ex: He works in this field as a scientist.
words.ex_cn: 他在这个领域作为一名科学家工作。
words.en: Within a particular area of study, work, or activity.

words.tr: pron. + n. 这个班级；这堂课
words.ex: This class is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这门课很简单。
words.en: Referring to a specific instructional session or course.

words.tr: v. 将会查看；将考虑
words.ex: I will look at the picture tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会看这张图片。
words.en: Will examine or investigate a particular subject or issue.

words.tr: phrase. 一篇文章的结构；指论文或文章的组织框架，通常包括引言、正文和结论三部分
words.ex: He learned the structure of an essay in his writing class.
words.ex_cn: 他在写作课上学到了文章的结构。
words.en: The organized framework and arrangement of ideas in a written piece.

words.tr: pron. 这家伙
words.ex: This guy likes to play basketball after school.
words.ex_cn: 这个家伙喜欢放学后打篮球。
words.en: This particular man (often used informally or dismissively).

words.tr: adj. 有资格领导这些团队的
words.ex: He is qualified to lead the groups.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格带领这些小组。
words.en: Possesses the necessary skills, knowledge, or authority to direct the groups.

words.tr: prep. 进入山中；往山里
words.ex: The tunnel goes into the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条隧道通向山里。
words.en: Moving or situated within the interior of a mountain.

words.tr: n. 今天早上的讲座
words.ex: This morning's lecture was about basic math.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上的讲座是关于基础数学的。
words.en: The academic talk or lesson scheduled for this morning.

words.tr: 介词短语，关于经济政策
words.ex: The debate focused on economic policy.
words.ex_cn: 这场辩论聚焦于经济政策。
words.en: Concerning policies related to the management of the economy.

words.tr: phrase. 被取消的
words.ex: The meeting has been canceled.
words.ex_cn: 会议已经被取消了。
words.en: Has been officially called off or stopped from happening.

words.tr: phrase. 我们的实验室设备
words.ex: Our laboratory equipment works well after the repair.
words.ex_cn: 我们的实验室设备在维修后运行良好。
words.en: Our laboratory equipment is provided before using any equipment in the workshop.

words.tr: adj. 免费提供的；不收费的
words.ex: The books were provided free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是免费提供的。
words.en: Given without payment or cost.

words.tr: n. 这家软件公司
words.ex: This software company creates easy apps for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家软件公司为儿童开发简单的应用程序。
words.en: A business that develops and sells computer programs.

words.tr: phrase. 设计并创造；构思并制作
words.ex: He designs and creates wooden chairs every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末设计并制作木制椅子。
words.en: Plans and makes something, especially for a specific purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 新产品；新上市的产品
words.ex: The company will launch new products next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将推出新产品。
words.en: New products refer to goods or services recently introduced to the market by a company.

words.tr: n. 交通；流量；
words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.w: the main cause of air pollution
words.tr: n. 空气污染的主要原因
words.uk: ðə meɪn kɔːz əv eə pəˌluːʃn
words.us: ðə meɪn kɔːz əv er pəˌluːʃn
words.ex: The main cause of air pollution is cars.
words.ex_cn: 空气污染的主要原因是汽车。
words.en: The primary reason for the contamination of the atmosphere.

words.tr: prep. 在许多城市中
words.ex: In many cities, people ride bikes to work.
words.ex_cn: 在许多城市里，人们骑自行车上班。
words.en: Occurring in numerous urban areas.

words.tr: pron. + noun. 这个项目
words.ex: This project is due next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目下周到期。
words.en: A specific planned undertaking or task.

words.tr: phrase. 被分成；被划分为
words.ex: The class is divided into two groups.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级被分成两个小组。
words.en: To be separated or categorized into distinct parts or sections.

words.tr: phrase. 四个主要部分
words.ex: The test has four main sections.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试有四个主要部分。
words.en: Four primary divisions or parts that form a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 大学学费；高等院校收取的费用
words.ex: The university fees have increased significantly this year.
words.ex_cn: n. 今年的大学学费大幅上涨。
words.en: The amount of money that students are required to pay for their education at a university.

words.tr: v. 预计会增加；被期望增长
words.ex: Prices are expected to increase next month.
words.ex_cn: 预计下个月价格会上涨。
words.en: Are anticipated to grow or rise in number or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 明年；来年
words.ex: I will go to London next year.
words.ex_cn: 我明年去伦敦。
words.en: The year following the current one.

words.tr: phrase. 校园内的水过滤器；用于净化饮用水的设备
words.ex: There are water filters on campus for students to drink safely.
words.ex_cn: 校园里有净水器，供学生安全饮水。
words.en: Devices installed on campus to purify drinking water.

words.tr: phrase. 将会阻止；将会使气馁；将会打消（某人做某事的念头）
words.ex: Hard rules will discourage students from asking questions.
words.ex_cn: 严格的规则会阻止学生提问。
words.en: Will deter or prevent someone from doing something.

words.tr: 短语：对……不必要的使用
words.ex: He avoids the unnecessary use of plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 他避免不必要的使用塑料袋。
words.en: The act of using something more than is necessary or needed.

words.tr: phrase. 塑料瓶
words.ex: Plastic bottles are commonly used for packaging liquids.
words.ex_cn: 塑料瓶常用于包装液体。
words.en: Plastic bottles are containers made from plastic materials, commonly used for storing liquids such as water, soft drinks, and other beverages.

words.tr: 短语. 我们可以一起工作
words.ex: We can work together to solve this algebra problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以一起解决这个代数问题。
words.en: We are able to cooperate or collaborate.

words.tr: phrase. 达到；实现；完成（目标、成就等）
words.ex: He works hard to achieve his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现他的目标。
words.en: To achieve means to successfully reach a desired objective or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.tr: n. 高教育标准；指教育质量或学术要求较高的水平
words.ex: The school has a high educational standard.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有很高的教育标准。
words.en: A high level of academic achievement or quality.

words.tr: 我们不能考虑增加
words.ex: We can't consider an increase in prices.
words.ex_cn: 我们不能考虑价格上涨。
words.en: We are unable to accept or allow a rise.

words.tr: phrase. 在我们的价格范围内；按我们的定价
words.ex: This laptop is in our price.
words.ex_cn: 这台笔记本电脑在我们的价格范围内。
words.en: Included in the cost we are charging.

words.tr: phrase. , 眼下；现阶段
words.ex: At this stage, he is learning to read.
words.ex_cn: 在这个阶段，他正在学习阅读。
words.en: At a particular point or step in a process or series of events.

words.tr: 我们能够联系
words.ex: We were able to contact the teacher after school.
words.ex_cn: 我们放学后成功联系到了老师。
words.en: We succeeded in reaching out to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 许多的；大量的
words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 研究对象；实验受试者；研究课题
words.ex: The research subjects were carefully selected to ensure diversity.
words.ex_cn: 研究对象经过精心挑选以确保多样性。
words.en: Research subjects refer to the individuals or groups that are studied in a research project.

words.tr: you can find 你能找到
words.ex: You can find the answer in the book.
words.ex_cn: 你可以在书中找到答案。
words.en: One is able to locate or discover.

words.tr: 短语. 多得多的信息；大量额外的信息
words.ex: The book gives a lot more information than the website.
words.ex_cn: 这本书比网站提供了多得多的信息。
words.en: A significantly greater amount of data or facts.

words.tr: 介词短语。在大学网站上
words.ex: The schedule is on the university website.
words.ex_cn: 课程表在大学网站上。
words.en: Located on the university's official internet site.
